transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?
I'm here because... well, I just feel like I'm always running hot. Like I can't shut the motor off. And, uh, lately that's been getting me in trouble at the firehouse.
Have you been feeling like your thoughts are racing or that you need much less sleep than usual?
No, I... I don't think so. I sleep fine, mostly. Just... normal sleep. And my thoughts aren't really racing, it's just... I just can't sit still.
Have you found yourself talking more than usual or feeling like you need to keep talking because your thoughts are coming out too fast?
No. Not really. I'm... I don't talk all that much, honestly. Just normal, I guess.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energized, overly confident, or took on more tasks than usual without feeling tired?
Uh, no. Not really. I mean, I get tired just like anyone else. I don't... I don't think I ever feel like that. Just the usual, I guess.
Do you ever feel like you have to move around, fidget, or can't stay in one place because you feel physically restless?

Yeah, I guess. Um... like if I'm stuck sitting in a meeting, my leg is usually bouncing. Or I'll be clicking a pen, just... shifting around in the chair. I don't really notice I'm doing it most of the time. Just messing with whatever is in front of me, I suppose.
Do you ever feel an inner restlessness or a need to keep moving even when you're not anxious or bored?

Yeah, I suppose. Um... like in command meetings. It just feels like... I don't know, my body is revving too high. I just get this urge to stand up. Go walk the bay, check the rigs... just do anything besides staying planted in that chair.
Do you ever find it hard to focus or stay on task, like your mind wanders or you get distracted easily?

Yeah. Um... I guess so. It doesn't take much. Like... a radio chirp, or somebody walking past the bay. Or even just... I don't know, a thought about a call from yesterday. It just knocks me off what I’m doing. And... yeah, it takes me forever to get back on track after that.
When did you first start noticing these feelings of restlessness or difficulty focusing? Were they something you experienced as a kid or teenager, or did they start more recently?

I guess it's been a while. Um... my mom says I was like this back in grade school, too. Always out of my seat, blurting out answers, that kind of thing. I'd lose my homework a lot. She'd get notes sent home from the teachers, even though they said I was bright enough to do the work. So... yeah, it's not new.
Have these feelings of restlessness or difficulty focusing ever caused problems for you outside of work, like at home or in your personal relationships?

Yeah... I suppose so. Um... even on my days off, it's... it's hard to just do quiet stuff with the family. I usually end up talking, or moving around. Or I'll just go out to the garage and check on tools... I just get up before I've really been sitting all that long.
